name: Government Service Center
description: Monitors government service center queues (Aadhar, Digital India) for crowding and emergency situations near service panels.

levels.title: Queue Crowding Alert
levels.message: There is undue crowding in the Aadhar services queue. Consider opening another queue to handle the crowd of people.

levels.title: Emergency Alert
levels.message: A person appears to have fallen near the Aadhar services queue area. Please select an immediate response action below.
actions: Send notification to Aadhar services Assistance
Trigger the buzzer asking for attention
